topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me about using a corner of my yard for a garden, I saw an opportunity rather than a request. I thought about the space, underutilized and often overlooked, and how it could bloom with life and color. I envisioned tomatoes ripening in the sun, rows of vibrant flowers, and the possibility of sharing in the harvest. It wasn’t just a plot of land; it was a chance to grow something beautiful together, to foster a bit of community right in my backyard. I said yes, and in that moment, I felt the beginnings of a new chapter unfolding, one where the boundaries between our properties blurred to make way for something greater.
